analysis.unit: paired repository clusters, retaining task repeats and arms together
analysis.zero_accepted_runs: No finite cost-per-success and no savings gate pass.

approval_record.user_statement: for openai models lets just use the subscription plan to do the benchmarking etc (if its part of the plan it does not count as the $15 reserve etc) + approve 20% savings target

before_held_out.execution_gate: Criteria approved; held-out execution remains locked until all qualification and complete-schedule feasibility requirements are evidenced.
before_held_out.input_admission: Replace the rejected byte-only context guard; verify a defensible model-compatible token bound and successful task completion on development before confirmation.

evaluation_budget.current_affordability: unestablished; zero accepted pilot runs cannot support a reliable success-cost forecast
evaluation_budget.includes: task, worker, failure/retry, in-flight, access and independent assessment API exposure; no paid cloud resources

subscription_policy.accounting: Track observable tokens, quota/credits, failures, retries and assessments separately; included use remains subject to the same active-time, trial and resource limits. Unknown usage stays unknown.
subscription_policy.implementation_status: Policy frozen; existing API pilot controller does not implement subscription execution. Validate the native subscription benchmark route before dependent runs.
subscription_policy.paid_usage: All non-included paid usage counts toward the USD 15 reserve. No automatic paid fallback, purchased credits or top-up.
subscription_policy.preferred_openai_route: Native Codex Sign in with ChatGPT where the existing subscription includes the requested model and workflow.
subscription_policy.preflight: Verify actual account entitlement, billing route and remaining quota before scheduling; include quota and time in full-schedule feasibility.

latency_resources.native_rss_enforcement: sampled, not a hard OS guarantee

quality.disagreements: Retain original dimensions and existing aggregation. Unresolved disagreements or missing assessment evidence block certification; no post-result assessor substitution.

retesting.confirmatory_failure: Stop; develop and validate changes outside held-out data. A fresh independent confirmation cohort and revised protocol require user approval.
retesting.replacement_rule: Record evidence; rerun all three arms symmetrically inside the same allowance; keep original failed costs and do not count replacements as new independent samples.

savings.metric: total task API estimated/actual spending across successes and failures divided by completed runs accepted by executable checks; independent review is a separate required quality gate
savings.subscription_evidence: Subscription runs may establish quality, latency and observed token/quota outcomes. Report API-rate projections separately as counterfactual estimates; subscription-only evidence does not certify the metered API dollar savings gate. Match authentication route across comparison arms.

trials.focused_scenarios: Three repeats for each retained focused contract; report separately from both suite gates.
trials.reuse: Evaluate separately with immutable seeds before making reuse claims; never pool cold and reuse costs.
